proposedBoundProperty.name: Assumption-dependent bound value
proposedBoundProperty.description: Source-reported signed bound on an effect under stated identification assumptions, in the outcome's unit. Distinct from a point effect and a confidence-interval endpoint.

groups.estimand: Effect of original randomized tutoring assignment on participation
groups.dashboardPolicy: Participation first stage; not an academic outcome effect.

groups.estimand: Weighted effect per year of tutoring participation, measured in year two
groups.dashboardPolicy: Per-year dose mixture; not an ordinary binary tutoring TOT estimate.

groups.estimand: Bound on persistent first-year benefit assuming zero incremental second-year benefit
groups.dashboardPolicy: Keep outside point-effect comparisons and confidence-interval fields.

groups.estimand: Bound on two-year participation benefit assuming zero persistence among first-year-only participants
groups.dashboardPolicy: Keep outside point-effect comparisons and confidence-interval fields.

signedBoundPolicy: Preserve printed signs. Course-failure bounds describe the beneficial reduction direction; do not call a negative value a generic upper numerical endpoint or silently take its absolute value.
uncertaintyPolicy: Retain each reported SE and specification-specific FDR q-value. A bound estimator's SE does not turn the bound into a confidence limit.
